record: issue-77 single-corner diagnosis probe 3: kelvin control return + 100 MHz single-pole EA stand-in, R15 start-up (simulated, pre-layout; NOT measured)
engine: ngspice (the klt-launched binary; `ngspice --version` on this host reports ngspice-42)
corner: typical / Vin 5.0 V / 27 C / no load (iload=0); Vin ramps 0->5 V over 10 us, EN at 20 us

run.tran: 2.5n 700u (saved from 15u), step_max 2.5 ns (max saved step 2.50 ns)
run.change_vs_bench.spice: (a) control domain on its own return wire to board 0 (gnd_d vs gnd_p, as in #82's kelvin probe); (b) the adopted error amplifier replaced by a 100 MHz single-pole stand-in (a probe, not a design); everything else as sim/soft-start/bench.spice
run.steady_state: not established as a spec 0.4 settled test (not run); 40 us window means of Vout are 1.772-1.774 V from 260 us to 700 us

observations.t_90: 175.6 us after EN (threshold 1.62 V on the per-cycle mean, buckmeas.soft_start), inside the R15 window 100-500 us
observations.peak_il: 0.405 A during start-up, below the 0.70 A R16 minimum trip
observations.monotonic: FALSE by the 1 mV R15 tolerance: max drawdown of a cycle mean below its running maximum is 20.7 mV, at 187 us (Vout about 1.52 V, 32 us before the soft-start reference flattens). Cause not traced
observations.final_vout: 1.772-1.774 V from 260 us (3 x vref 0.591 V), 1.5 % below 1.8 V; the same offset as #82's third addendum, not examined here
observations.bias_and_oscillator: vc-gnd_d 1.26-1.48 V from 60 us, inside the 1.18-1.80 V ramp window; no deviation in the oscillator or soft-start reference

diagnosis: PARTIAL (CONFIRMED for the cause of the earlier failures; R15 as a whole is not shown to pass). With the control ground separated and the EA's GBW not limiting, the previously failing typical/5 V/27 C/no-load unit starts up: Vout reaches 90 % at 175.6 us and holds 1.77 V. The earlier t_90 failures (Vout stuck near 1.55 V) are therefore the two causes already diagnosed in #82: the die-ground bounce (bench artifact) and the unstable loop with the adopted error amplifier (design defect, spec/decision-records/0004). They are not an oscillator, bias or soft-start-reference fault. This record does NOT show the adopted netlist passes R15: the EA here is a stand-in and the bench has a separate control return, both decisions still open (0004, #87). The 20.7 mV drawdown means the monotonic clause is not met even with the stand-in. No spec row, decision record or design netlist is changed.
not_done: other corners (31 of 33 grid units fail, 10 never reach 90 %); the 3.6 ohm load; R16 (trip level at 0.08-1.0 A was not probed; likely the same non-regulation, not shown); the monotonic drawdown; the 1.5 % Vout offset; the grid (#60, held until decision 0004 is made)
